claim:
For any positive transversal order-2 periodic orbit of the bilateral impulsive Leslie–Gower system (2.1) of Xu--Shen--Cao (2026), label the smooth legs by \(A\to B\) and \(C\to D\), where \(x_A=(1+p_1)h_1\), \(x_B=h_2\), \(x_C=(1-p_2)h_2\), \(x_D=h_1\), \(y_C=y_B+\tau_2\), and \(y_D=y_A+\tau_1\). With \(\Delta_1,\Delta_2\) and \(L_2\) exactly as defined in Theorem 3.5, the nontrivial Floquet multiplier obtained from the paper's own unsimplified divergence formula is
\[
\mu=\Delta_1\Delta_2L_2\,
\frac{y_B(y_A+\tau_1)}{(1+p_1)(1-p_2)y_A(y_B+\tau_2)}.
\]
Theorem 3.5 instead prints the endpoint factor
\[
\frac{1-p_2}{1+p_1}\frac{(y_A+\tau_1)(y_B+\tau_2)}{y_Ay_B}.
\]
Consequently the printed multiplier divided by the corrected multiplier is exactly
\[
(1-p_2)^2\left(\frac{y_B+\tau_2}{y_B}\right)^2,
\]
so the two formulas agree exactly when \((1-p_2)(y_B+\tau_2)=y_B\). Thus the upper-threshold endpoint ratios in the final displayed simplification of Theorem 3.5 are inverted in general. This claim is conditional on existence and transversality of the positive order-2 orbit and does not alter the paper's separate existence theorem or assert a stability reversal for its numerical example.
integrity: The result is derived from the source's unsimplified divergence multiplier and exact endpoint identities. The bundled checker uses exact rational arithmetic only as a replay of the algebra, not as a substitute for the symbolic proof.
scientific_limitations: Conditional on existence of a positive transversal order-2 cycle. The result corrects only the final Floquet-factor simplification in Theorem 3.5 and does not assess Theorem 3.4 existence, grazing impacts, global dynamics, or claim a stability reversal for the numerical example.
title: Corrected Floquet factor for the bilateral Leslie–Gower cycle
